guidelines.text: Search before you post. Your question may already have an answer.
Put the module code in your title, like ST2133.
Accept the answer that helped, so the next person finds it.
Never share exam questions while an exam window is open.
Be kind. Everyone here is revising too.

tips.text: Ask one clear question in the title.
Say what you’ve tried so far and where you got stuck.
Pick the module so the right cohort sees it.
Put formulas between $ signs, and code in backticks.
